$comment: Maps each HERMETIC Playwright e2e spec (apps/web-e2e/src/tests/) to the source surfaces it exercises. Used by .github/scripts/integration-select/select-specs.mjs (shared engine) to run only the affected specs on a PR, in addition to the always-on @critical safety net (LS-7846). This file is the maintained source of truth: when a spec starts covering a new area, add the glob here. Globs support ** (cross-segment) and * (within-segment). Over-selection is safe; under-selection risks a missed regression, so lean broad. When adding a NEW e2e spec, add an entry here (.github/checks/integration-select-tests.sh enforces coverage). This map is also the seed data for the LS-7850 drift auditor.
